acceptanceCriteria.description: [happy] Given this repository's chain at the slice head, when every user story is read, then no tags entry starts "verification:", and every criterion that carried a "verification:<AC id>=<flag>" tag at the parent of the move commit carries "verification" equal to that flag; node bin/rcf.js define validate exits 0.
[must-not] Moving the flags changes no criterion text: for every criterion moved, its description, given, when, then, testable and supersession fields are byte-identical before and after the move.

[failure] Given a 0.37.0 criterion left without the field after the move, when node bin/rcf.js define validate --base <the merge-base of the DEFINE branch with main> runs, then it exits 3 naming that criterion as new since the base with no verification flag, so a missed move fails CI.
